**Steps to follow in requesting a feature with `goodpractice`**

Please provide reproducible code generated by the [`reprex` package](https://reprex.tidyverse.org) to demonstrate current behaviour of `goodpractice` which you would like changed or improved, including the following lines in your `reprex`:
``` r
# <your reprex code here>
u <- "https://github.com/<org>/<repo>"
path <- gert::git_clone(u, file.path(tempdir(), basename(u)))
g <- goodpractice::gp(path)

packageVersion("goodpractice")
R.Version()$version.string
#sessionInfo()
```

Please use the results of the preceding step to explain precisely what you would like modified from or added to the results as given.

Thanks! :smile:
